title: 呵.tw
description: AI-native URL shortener and paste handoff MCP service for cross-session agent collaboration.

tools.name: hotw_shorten
tools.description: Shorten a long URL into a memorable 呵.tw link and return the short URL plus QR code URL.

tools.name: hotw_create_paste
tools.description: Create a text, markdown, or code paste for agent handoff with optional metadata such as summary, tags, and parent linkage.

format.description: Optional content format, for example text, markdown, or code.

summary.description: Optional short summary for agent-friendly discovery.

parent_slug.description: Optional parent paste slug for threaded handoff chains.

tools.name: hotw_resolve
tools.description: Resolve a slug and return either the original URL or paste metadata.

tools.name: hotw_qr_url
tools.description: Return a QR code image URL for a short link or paste slug.

slug.description: The slug to generate a QR code for.

is_paste.description: Set true when the slug refers to `/p/<slug>` instead of a short redirect.

tools.name: hotw_find_by_tag
tools.description: Find pastes by exact tag match.
